course_name_original: History of Discovery of the Universe
course_name_en: History of Discovery of the Universe

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with a set of basic information about the twists and turns of people looking for a place in the Universe. Planet Earth - a miniature space object.

syllabus_topics: Copernicus, Tycho Brahe, Kepler, and their time. Newton. Mechanistic view of the Universe.
Brief review of our knowledge about surrounding Universe.
Solar System and the Universe - the development of the description and understanding.
The development of astronomical instruments. Galileo Galilei, Johannes Kepler - the development of optics for astronomy
The development of science as a result of improving the signal-to-noise ratio - option ground-based astronomy. How to measure distances in the Universe?
Space technology for Earth observation and space.
The Earth - Isle of life and our (real) home? Gaia theory.
Risks of current environmental projects and views on the stability of living conditions.
Energy and its role in the evolution of mankind.
Technology, economy and ecology - the current view of the facts and superstitions.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
